title: All Avalonia views authored in AXAML + MVVM
body: Every Avalonia view in ViceSharp.Avalonia is authored declaratively in AXAML with MVVM bindings (no imperative control-tree construction in code-behind), to ease maintenance. The shell window, the sidebar, each per-peripheral control, and the settings panel are AXAML UserControls/Windows bound to view models; code-behind is limited to InitializeComponent and thin glue.
